base.srHeading: Frequently asked questions and next steps

faq.question: What are AI Credits?
faq.answer: AI Credits are Interfy.ai's single artificial intelligence currency. Every AI-powered operation — reading, extraction, classification, running agents, and more — consumes a number of credits based on the task's complexity.

faq.question: Can I share AI Credits between Workspaces?
faq.answer: No. Each Workspace has its own AI Credits balance, with independent limits and permissions, giving you full control over consumption per area or team.

faq.question: Can I buy additional credits at any time?
faq.answer: Yes. You can purchase additional AI Credits packages whenever you need, directly from the platform, without changing your plan.

faq.question: Do AI Credits expire?
faq.answer: Credits included in your plan renew every billing cycle. Additional packages you purchase follow the agreed terms — contact our team for details.

faq.question: How is consumption calculated?
faq.answer: Consumption varies by the type, complexity, and volume of each operation. Simple tasks, like classification, use fewer credits; more complex processes, like running agents, use more.

faq.question: Are AI Credits included in the plans?
faq.answer: Yes. Every Interfy.ai plan includes an AI Credits balance for intelligent processing. If you need more, you can buy additional credits at any time.
